Particle P has an atomic number of 18, a mass number of 40 and no overall charge.
Particle Q has an atomic number of 19, a mass number of 40 and a single positive charge.
Which statement is correct?
A
They are isotopes of the same element.
B
They are both ions.
C
Q has more neutrons than P.
D
They have the same number of electrons in their outer shell.

options.label: A
options.text: They are isotopes of the same element.

options.label: C
options.text: Q has more neutrons than P.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of electrons in their outer shell.
